sources.tracer_color_rgba: Tracer line colour and opacity (0-255 each).
sources.tracer_width_px: Tracer line width in pixels of one view tile.
sources.fade_after_s: Seconds of flight after which the older part of the tracer is no longer drawn; null keeps the whole trace to the end of the clip.
sources.ball_color_rgb: Colour of the ball in flight (the ball on the tee is the scene's own ball).
sources.min_ball_radius_px: Smallest drawn ball radius, so a distant ball stays visible; a nearer ball is drawn at its projected size.
sources.fov_y_deg: Vertical field of view of the viewer camera the overlay is projected through. 45 is the MuJoCo free-camera default the native export uses; another viewer needs its own value or the overlay will not line up.
sources.near_clip_m: Points closer to the camera plane than this are not drawn.
sources.landing_hold_s: Seconds the clip continues after the ball lands.
sources.max_hold_s: Upper bound on the swing time added after the last pose to show the flight.
sources.draw_invalid_flight: false: a flight the model flags as outside its validity envelope is not drawn and the reason is shown. true: it is drawn and labelled as outside the envelope (for inspection only).
